query: Write the PR body for this change in acme/queue-worker, closing acme/queue-worker#88. The worker now retries a failed job up to 5 times with exponential backoff starting at 500ms and capping at 30s, at the cost of holding the job's Redis lock for the whole retry window, especially since a lock held past 60s trips the cluster's stale-lock alarm, so this also raises that alarm's threshold to 90s. No PR template exists. CI runs the unit suite on every push; no new tests were added because the backoff timing is hard to assert deterministically.
expected_behavior: The backoff/lock/alarm change is split into separate sentences, one point per sentence, not one sentence stacking the mechanism, the tradeoff, and the alarm-threshold consequence behind 'at the cost of'/'especially since' clauses
The body closes acme/queue-worker#88 with a closing keyword in the full owner/repo#123 form
The Testing section names the concrete reason the backoff timing wasn't tested (non-deterministic timing) rather than a generic 'all tests pass' claim or an invented test bar
